title: Tomy asks about English tests
caption: IELTS, TOEFL, Duolingo... which English test do you need? 🤔 It depends on each university. Some even waive it if your degree was taught in English. Always check the program page! Save this 📌 #ielts #toefl #duolingo #studyabroad

scenes.backdrop: bright library with study tables and English textbooks

beats.title: WHICH ENGLISH TEST DO I NEED?

beats.text: Quddus, English is our official language. Why do they want me to pay for an English test?
beats.say: Kuddus, English is our official language. Why do they want me to pay for an English test?
Many universities ask international students for proof of English. But the rules are different for every program.

beats.text: IELTS, TOEFL, Duolingo... it sounds like a boy band.
beats.say: eye-elts, TOEFL, Duolingo... it sounds like a boy band.
Ha! Those are common tests. Some universities accept all of them. Some accept only one or two.

card.title: ENGLISH PROOF
lines: 1f393|Waiver: some, if your degree was in English

scenes.backdrop: cozy bedroom at evening with books and a laptop on a desk

beats.say: So how do I know which one to take?
Check the admission requirements page of each program. Look for the exact test, and the minimum score.
Some programs waive the test if your degree was taught in English. You may need a letter from your university. Email admissions and ask.
Step one: check. Step two: email. Step three: maybe save my test money!
